svg.aria-label: ICE: an infinite canvas that shows its work
svg.title: ICE: an infinite canvas that shows its work
svg.desc: Two planes, one above the other. The upper one is the desk: a cutting mat with a whiteboard, two notes, a pointer and another person's hand on it; one renderer draws it. The lower one is the world, one ECS, drawn as a table. Three lines run down from a note, the pointer and the other hand to three rows of the table, labelled durable, runtime and ephemeral. Every thing on the desk is a row.
